territories.name: Zimbabwe
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. The Republic of Zimbabwe levies its own value added tax under the Value Added Tax Act [Chapter 23:12], administered by the Zimbabwe Revenue Authority, at the rate the Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] fixes — fifteen comma five per centum from 1 January 2026 (Finance Act, 2025, section 34) — on supplies by registered operators, on imported goods and on imported services.
